description: Every play of one NFL game from nflverse play-by-play (1999–current): down, distance, field position, play type, yards, the official play description, passer/rusher/receiver, score, expected points added (EPA) and win probability. Filter by quarter or play type. Find game ids with nfl_schedule.

limit.description: Max plays returned (default 300, max 400). A full game is ~150–200 rows.

name: nfl_play_by_play
title: Nfl Play By Play
